title: RDP: Do not crash on reassembly when the first fragment is missing
description:
If the array to store the chunks is NULL (because the first fragment
was missed), don't try to append it, just leave the chunk as
unreassembled.

Don't create a second unused array in the last frame, since it gets
created in the first frame.

Don't pass a captured length to tvb_new_real_data that is longer
than the actually captured length in the case of missing chunks.

RDP has a reassembly type similar to that of BTHCI ISO, where there
are first and last frags and no explicit fragment numbers (so that
fragments must be received in order), but the total octet length of
the reassembly is known. We should probably have a fragment_add_next()
in reassemble.h that is similar to fragment_add_seq_next() except
that fragment_set_tot_len() would set the expected number of bytes
instead of expected number of fragments.

Fix #20973

Fixup 4d6ee2a8e5afcea801463d8a5fae9b94039521a4
